articles.summary: GLENS FALLS, N.Y. (March 18, 2026) — The Arrow Family of Companies is proud to announce its 2025 community giving totaling $1,054,048, marking the first time the organization exceeded $1 million in annual giving. This total includes $931,360 in corporate contributions to 424 organizations, as well as $122,688 in employee contributions. 2025 Impact by the Numbers $1,054,048 in total community giving — the first time Arrow has exceeded $1 million in annual donations. ...
articles.title: Arrow Family of Companies Exceeds $1 Million in Giving and 13,700 Volunteer Hours
